test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 16 May, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Eight friends Anil, Kamal, Ram, Sanjay, Aakash, Vivek, Rahul and Ramu are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre (not necessarily in the same order). Ram is to the immediate right of Anil. Anil is fourth to the right of Sanjay. Rahul is fourth to the left of Aakash. Aakash is second to the left of Anil. Ramu is second to the left of Kamal. Vivek is second to the right of Kamal. Who is second to the right of Vivek?
solution: As per the given information: 1. Ram is to the immediate right of Anil and Anil is fourth to the right of Sanjay. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2b69cb5d9c3d860ac1aaed038c6f85b689203925df1d566bcfafbca518884c07.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/352c98511df294bfe8655e3b40026c68110cde1b170cb160d7b683350194596b.png] 2. Aakash is second to the left of Anil and Rahul is fourth to the left of Aakash.
